description: Stitch-timing experiment. survival: no judge, splice left/right donors at step k (noise spliced the same way) and check whether each half keeps the donor's reference digit (evaluator). judge_curve: judge on reference x0_hat every 5 steps vs evaluator class of the final image. sweep: method C lam=3 N=4 1000 batches seed 0 with resampling restricted to steps >= k (fromK) or <= k (untilK).
